items.label: Abaxent
items.title: Making an unfamiliar service easy to grasp
items.summary: We built the site around a single question: what is a technology broker? From there it walks visitors through how brokering works, the impact it has, past work and certifications.

items.label: NAMC 2027
items.title: A conference site that does the work of a front desk
items.summary: For the National Association of Minority Contractors, we built the whole event experience: selling tickets and sponsorships, helping small businesses find the right meetings, and giving every attendee a digital pass.

items.label: Milo's Cafe

shots.alt: Milo's Cafe home page with the storefront and the headline A little Europe, a lot of flavor
Milo's Cafe patio scene at golden hour with a time-of-day slider and sky options

items.title: A café site that tells you whether it's a patio day
items.summary: Milo's is a European-style café in Morrisville, NC, known for focaccia sandwiches, Lavazza espresso and crepes. We built a one-page site around the questions a hungry visitor actually has: what is on the menu, are you open, and is it nice enough to sit outside.

items.label: Summit
items.title: Turning messy project discovery into a plan
items.summary: Summit is a product for Shopify agencies and consultants. It turns scattered discovery notes into requirements, risk assessments, roadmaps and QA plans. The site had to explain that quickly to teams who live in spreadsheets and inboxes.

items.label: Iron Clad
items.title: A live odds terminal that shows its working
items.summary: Iron Clad is an independent sports analytics site covering MLB, NFL, NBA, NHL and WNBA. It streams current market prices, ranks three daily parlays by probability and value rather than payout, and explains each pick in plain English.

items.label: happy's
items.note: Concept site, not a launched project

shots.alt: happy's concept home page: a wall of smiley faces behind the headline come by, feel good
happy's concept walk-up teaser: a three-dimensional staircase climbing toward a doorway

items.title: A cocktail bar site that feels like the room
items.summary: happy's is a cocktail bar and event space in downtown Cary, NC. We designed this concept to show how the bar's smiley-covered wall, its long menu and its irregular opening hours could work together as one loud, friendly page.

items.label: The WalkUp
items.note: Concept site, not a launched project

shots.alt: The WalkUp concept home page: the gold script logo over the painted brick wall of the upstairs lounge
The WalkUp concept menu: specialty cocktail cards on a limewashed background with a running tab

items.title: A bar site you climb
items.summary: The WalkUp is a cocktail bar one flight up in downtown Cary, NC, right above happy's. This concept turns the stairs into the page: a 14-step meter fills as you scroll from the street to Suite 200.
